summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue $38,000,000 in bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $49 per $100,000 of assessed value (about $2,155,000 annually) while the bonds are outstanding, to repair or replace roofs and heating/ventilation/air-conditioning systems and to construct or improve science, technology, engineering, arts, mathematics, agriculture, and career technical education…
